text_block_list.text:
One morning, as I'm heading to the track
to do
training preparations...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? Didn't get much
sleep? You're
the one who asked me to
train with you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I was up all night reading fan
letters.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Oh, fan letters, huh? Did you get
anything out of
them?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
...No. In fact, they left me feeling
puzzled.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I know fans are important and I really
appreciate
their support...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: But I'm not sure what I can do in return...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I see... Let me ask you something,
Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Did any of the letters actually ask you to
do
something?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Huh? Um... Well, I'm not sure exactly.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I think you'd better take another, closer
look at
them.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I'm sure you'll get it then.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Ah, okay. I'll pay closer attention to them. Thanks... Yawn.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Please do, but also make sure you get
enough
sleЭпизод Your fans will be
disappointed if they see
you looking
sloppy.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
As she sees Сайленс Судзука stifle another
yawn, a
gentle smile spreads across Air
Groove's face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
